description: This file defines a UI component named 'NotesList' for a frontend application, likely using a framework like LightningJS or a similar component-based framework. The component displays a list of notes, supports search filtering, and user interactions such as creating notes and navigating the list.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A LightningJS component that renders a list of notes, with search and navigation functionality.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest notes from NoteService and updates the view.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters notes based on the search query q and updates focus and selection accordingly.

methods.name: ensureOnSelect
methods.description: Ensures the currently focused note is selected via the onSelect callback.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and re-filters the notes list.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new note using NoteService and updates the list, focusing on the new note.

methods.name: focusNext
methods.description: Moves focus down the list of notes.

methods.name: focusPrev
methods.description: Moves focus up the list of notes.

methods.name: $rowColor
methods.description: Determines the background color of a note row, highlighting the selected note.

methods.name: $rowAlpha
methods.description: Determines the transparency level for a note row, highlighting the selected note.

methods.name: $time
methods.description: Formats the ISO date string into a human-readable 'Edited' timestamp.
